title: ControlCheckResult
description: Machine-readable result from a single house security scanner check (no secrets).

scanner_id.description: Stable scanner id; matches security/waivers/<scanner_id>.yaml stem.

check_id.description: Usually equals scanner_id for baseline 1:1 scanners.

framework_id.description: Optional framework id when check comes from a framework repo (cis-controls, etc.).

name.description: Human-readable scanner name for compliance table.

compliance_pct.description: Raw score before waiver (waived rows keep raw %; not forced to 100).

waiver_path.description: Relative path to per-scanner waiver if present.
